# A test reads a field of a map's value by its key. Kotlin's own get answers
# null, so the app's code writes `(m[k] ?: zero)`; the test lowering wrote a
# bare `m[k]`, and kotlinc refused `.round` on a nullable -- the Pokédex's test
# of a failed dex asking again.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Tried {
    round int
}

var tries map[string, Tried] = {"a"=Tried{round=0}}

component retry ui.node {
    ui.button #again(text="again", @click {
        tries["a"] = Tried{round=tries["a"].round + 1}
    })
}

func testTheRoundIsReadByKey(t test.Test, c retry) {
    t.assert(tries["a"].round == 0)
    c.again.click()
    t.assert(tries["a"].round == 1)
}

ui.window {
    retry
}
-- testrun/android/kotlin/app.sngl/retry/1 --
sha256:817f745cba6c0bfb0077e2d155c46314
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "TheRoundIsReadByKey",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
